title: What Is the True Purpose of Human Evolution? (1986-10-09)
description:
Struggling with emotional extremes and chronic stress? Discover the energetic roots of illness and how to awaken your innate healing power.

This public program explores the purpose of our evolution and how awakening the Kundalini makes us collectively conscious. Shri Mataji explains the spiritual roots of psychosomatic diseases, the function of the left energy channel, and the importance of achieving true inner peace.

Key Topics:
• 🌟 Understanding human evolution from carbon to Spirit and the ultimate purpose of achieving Self-realization spontaneously
• 🌙 The role of Ida Nadi (left energy channel) and how the collective subconscious influences emotional extremes and illnesses
• 🔬 The spiritual root of psychosomatic diseases, and how utilizing elements like fire and earth can clear negative energies
• 💭 Why intellectual understanding and reading scriptures cannot substitute the actual experience of Kundalini awakening on your nervous system
• ❤️ The significance of the Heart Center in creating antibodies and protecting our subtle being from negative influences

“You feel the peace within yourself. The whole turmoil is there and inside you feel that peace. You are not disturbed any way.”
— Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi

Common Questions About Spiritual Awakening:
• What is the spiritual cause of psychosomatic diseases?
• How does the collective subconscious affect mental health?
• How to experience true inner peace when surrounded by chaos?

Have you ever felt a deep sense of inner peace despite the chaos around you? What helps you stay centered in your daily life?
